idea-plugin.name: AI Output Disclosure Lint SB 942
idea-plugin.description:
Finds the generative-AI code that drops the disclosures California SB 942 has required since August 2, 2026.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → AI Output Disclosure Lint SB 942: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 12 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/ai-disclosure-lint-sb942 (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/ai-disclosure-lint-sb942

action.text: AI Output Disclosure Lint SB 942: Check This File
action.description: Run AI Output Disclosure Lint SB 942 on the file in the editor
